title: Settings
subtitle: Everything is on by default except “Aula always on”. Change only what you need.

ai.title: Your AI
ai.notReadyBody: Pick one to create courses, grade open answers and talk with Aula. Studying what you already have works without AI.
ai.auto: Automatic: Aula uses the best one you have
ai.claudeReady: Claude Code installed and signed in
ai.claudeMissing: Install Claude Code and run “claude” once in a terminal

chatgptLogin.starting: Getting ready to connect to ChatGPT…
chatgptLogin.browser: Sign in to ChatGPT in your browser to finish
chatgptLogin.browserHint: If the page didn’t open, or you closed the tab, open it again. When you’re done, come back here and Aula will pick it up on its own.
chatgptLogin.device: Open the ChatGPT page and enter this code:
chatgptLogin.useCode: Sign in with a code instead

ai.keySafe: Your key is stored encrypted on this computer and only sent to its provider.
ai.parallel: Agents at once when creating a course
ai.localNone: This computer doesn’t have enough memory for a local model to run well. If you install Ollama or LM Studio, Aula will use them automatically.
ai.localChecking: Checking what this computer can run…

custom.title: Another OpenAI-compatible service
custom.key: Key (if the service asks for one)
custom.keyKept: Saved ({{hint}}): leave empty to keep it
custom.keyInvalid: The key has characters that don’t work: copy it again.
custom.hint: vLLM, llama.cpp, Together, your own gateway…

url.invalid: That URL isn’t valid. It should look like https://api.example.com/v1.
url.insecure: Use https://. http:// only works for a server on this computer (localhost).

spend.capHint: When it’s reached, Aula stops and carries on the next day.
spend.reached: You reached today’s cap: there’s room again tomorrow.
spend.customUnknown: With a cap, Aula won’t use your own service because it doesn’t know its price.
spend.notCounted: Subscriptions and models on this computer don’t count.

platforms.title: Your platforms
platforms.hint: Sign in once and Aula keeps the session: no more signing in every time.
platforms.addPlaceholder: Paste your school platform’s web address
platforms.keepSignedInHint: Aula stores the cookies encrypted and refreshes the session in the background.
platforms.none: No platforms. You can study with your own files only.
platforms.signedInDetail: Aula can read your platform now. It only reads: it never submits or starts anything.
platforms.waiting: Waiting for you to sign in in the window
platforms.notYet: Aula doesn’t see you signed in yet
platforms.notYetHint: Finish signing in in the window (two-step verification too). As soon as you see your dashboard, Aula will notice.

data.title: Privacy and data
data.memoryHint: Aula remembers your exams, how you like explanations and what you find hard. Never passwords or keys.
data.webHint: To create courses and answer with current sources.
data.deleteConfirm: Delete all your courses, progress and settings?
data.deleteConfirmBody: This can’t be undone: Aula restarts and starts from scratch. Export what you want to keep first.

about.title: About Aula
about.license: Free software: you can share and change it under the GNU AGPL v3. It comes with absolutely no warranty.
about.noKeyring: This system has no keyring: your keys and sessions are stored with file permissions only, unencrypted. Install GNOME Keyring or KWallet to protect them.

memory.title: What Aula remembers
memory.body: Your preferences, exams and what you find hard, to help you better. Only on this computer.
memory.off: Turned off in Privacy and data
memory.clearBody: It’s deleted for good, including from change-history copies.
memory.empty: It doesn’t remember anything yet. It’ll learn from your conversations and how you study.
